title: Loop Body Source Machine
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, with $k_B$ and $k_F$ work tapes, respectively, and let $a$ be a state of $B$. The loop body source machine has $k_B+1+(1+k_F)$ work tapes and states in $Q_B\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$; its initial state is $(q_0^B,\mathrm{false})$. On a transition, it applies the transition of the loop body machine to the input and the first $k_B+1$ work tapes, using the corresponding initial segment of the larger machine's work-tape contents, and extends that action by the specified left-action operation over the remaining $1+k_F$ tapes.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the loop body machine or the left-action operation, so their precise transition behavior cannot be stated from this snippet.
